message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "override_low_confidence_classifier_with_visual_inspection", "description": "When automated chest X-ray classifiers return non-specific or low-confidence scores (no findings >0.8) during longitudinal comparison, rely on direct visual inspection of original images to identify structural progression.", "applicable_conditions": "Longitudinal medical imaging comparison tasks where automated diagnostic tools yield inconclusive or low-confidence results despite potential visible radiographic changes.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns no strong findings (confidence scores ≤0.8) for a longitudinal CXR comparison task: (1) Do not infer stability or lack of change based solely on score deltas; (2) Perform direct visual inspection of the original image series to identify subtle structural progression (e.g., increased pleural thickening, new cavities, changing opacity patterns); (3) Base the final interpretation on these visual findings rather than the classifier's low-confidence output."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
